title: WEF SmartStart New York curriculum correction — depth 4
summary: Official WEF testimony confirms New York as SmartStart's launch geography and names NASA, FIRST Robotics and Smithsonian Education as curriculum-reference models; exact school, district, funding and geographic granularity remain unresolved.

data.question: What stronger evidence resolves SmartStart's pilot geography and curriculum reference network?
data.method: Review official WEF podcast transcript and verify the named education organizations through their official sites.
data.framework: Corrective recursive analysis distinguishing launch geography, curriculum references and formal partnerships.
data.scope: SmartStart USA pilot geography and curriculum-development references.
findings: Kiva Allgood says SmartStart is launching in New York.
The transcript says more than 60 constituents from industry, academia and the public sector co-developed the curriculum.
The curriculum team examined practices from NASA, FIRST Robotics and Smithsonian Education.
Reviewed indexed New York public records do not yet identify the partner high school, district, contract or grant.
The New York State Smart Start computer-science grant is a pre-existing unrelated programme and must not be conflated with WEF SmartStart USA.
conclusions: New York supersedes Michigan and Kentucky as the primary source-backed launch-geography lead.
Michigan and Kentucky remain confirmed launch-coalition participants, not confirmed pilot locations.
NASA, FIRST and Smithsonian are curriculum-reference models on current evidence; formal partnership, licensing, funding or delivery roles are not established.
recommendations: Search New York State and New York City school, district, procurement and workforce records for the August 2026 partner high school.
Identify any implementation agreement, funding source, credential provider and Student & Teacher Portal vendor.
Preserve the unrelated NYSED Smart Start grant as a false-positive collision.
Seek a primary curriculum document to resolve grade range and exact Smithsonian unit.
counterarguments: New York may refer to the WEF office or programme-management base rather than the pilot school's physical location.
NASA, FIRST and Smithsonian may have been examples reviewed informally rather than institutional contributors.
limitations: The exact school and district remain undisclosed.
Smithsonian Education is not a unique legal entity name in the transcript.
No public award, procurement or implementation agreement has been located.
unresolved: New York City versus New York State.

caveats: New York is source-backed, but exact geography and school are unresolved.

workflow.next_action: Identify the exact New York partner school, district, funding and vendors.
